tagline: North America's largest less-than-truckload carrier, delivering industry-leading published transit times, service levels and reliability
hero_kpi_rationale: The business of FedEx Freight, the largest North American less-than-truckload carrier, reads first in physical volume. Average daily shipments open the table because it is the longest and freshest series, and it explains directly the fall in revenue and operating margin in fiscal 2026 despite higher revenue per shipment.

ai_positioning.summary: FedEx Freight has no artificial intelligence product to sell and discloses no AI-related revenue. It treats AI as an internal lever, announced as one of the three technology priorities after the spin-off, alongside exiting the transition service agreements and modernising legacy systems. The subject also appears as a risk, from competitors gaining ground through AI and autonomous trucking, and from new data and AI regulation.
evidence: At the first call with analysts as an independent company, on 25 June 2026, the chief executive ranked the responsible use of artificial intelligence across the organisation second among priorities, to gain efficiency and improve the customer experience.

The technology separation was completed during the quarter: more than a thousand applications separated, about 17,000 devices migrated, and a freight pricing system purpose-built for less-than-truckload put in service in May 2026 on a stack described as more modern and more flexible.
The fedexfreight.com site launched in May 2026 recorded nearly half a million unique visits and about 250,000 shipments scheduled online since opening.

The fiscal 2026 annual report lists the effect of technology developments among its risks, naming artificial intelligence and machine learning, and notes that some competitors could take greater advantage of emerging technologies such as AI and autonomous transportation.
The same report adds artificial intelligence laws to the complex regulations the company is subject to, alongside data privacy and cybersecurity.
